name: Vacuum Cleaner Hose
definition: A flexible airflow conduit between a vacuum body, wand, handle, cleaner head or tool; bore, length, cuff geometry, electrical contacts, swivel, seals and exact model scope must be approved together.
includedScope: Passive and powered vacuum cleaner hose assemblies
Upright, canister, handheld and stick-vacuum hose applications
Airway, cuff, latch, electrical and exact-model checks
excludedScope: Generic ducting without an approved machine interface
headline: Hose bore, cuff geometry and any electrical path must match the complete vacuum system.
description: This profile separates passive, stretch and powered vacuum hose assemblies and converts official service evidence into practical airflow, interface and fit checks.
metaDescription: Vacuum cleaner hose types, diameters, cuffs, powered contacts, airflow losses, failure symptoms and exact model compatibility checks.
disclaimer: Physical resemblance, matching wattage, matching voltage, a generic family name or a seller claim does not establish compatibility. Verify the current manufacturer part number and revision, machine model and serial scope, mechanical, electrical and fluid interfaces, rated operating envelope, protection requirements and approved service documentation.
